value.name: reads discharge addendum request
value.description: Asha reads Rosa's message explaining that the social worker needs an MDS-discharge addendum signed before Friday.
evidence: the form was called an MDS-discharge addendum, and the social worker would need it signed before Friday.

value.name: silently accepts message
value.description: Asha pockets her phone without replying, choosing not to respond to Rosa's request yet.
evidence: and slid the phone back into her pocket without replying.

value.name: prepares to drive
value.description: Asha unlocks her car, sets her bag on the passenger seat, and pauses with her hands on the wheel before starting the engine.
evidence: She unlocked the car, set the bag on the passenger seat, and sat for a moment with her hands on the wheel before she turned the key.

value.name: drives toward Trenton
value.description: Asha pulls away from the curb and drives toward Trenton, keeping the phone message in mind as she goes.
evidence: Asha pulled away from the curb and let the car carry her out toward the bridge
The phone stayed in her coat pocket, the name of the form Rosa had sent already filed in her head where she could reach it without looking: MDS-discharge addendum, signed before Friday.

value.name: avoids rehearsing confrontation
value.description: While driving, Asha refuses to rehearse what she will say at the facility because it would force her to choose among long-avoided answers.
evidence: She kept to the right lane through the city and watched the signs change over to Trenton without letting herself rehearse what she would say when she got there, because rehearsing would mean choosing among the three answers she had been refusing to choose for ten years.

value.name: turns down radio traffic report
value.description: After the radio switches to traffic, Asha turns it down but leaves it on and continues driving with both hands on the wheel.
evidence: Somewhere past the river the radio cut to traffic and she turned it down, not off, and drove on with both hands on the wheel.

value.name: arrives at facility
value.description: Asha follows the signs into Trenton, reaches the low brick facility, and turns into its visitor entrance.
evidence: The exit ramp narrowed into Trenton's surface streets, and Asha followed the signs through two intersections before the low brick face of the facility came up on her right, set back behind a strip of grass that had not yet recovered from winter.
She turned in, found a space near the visitor entrance, and put the car in park
